# Keys to AI

> Keys to AI teaches solopreneurs and one-person businesses how to use AI to automate their work — with practical, no-code workflows they can repeat. It is the companion site to the Keys to AI YouTube channel (@KeystoAIOfficial). Tagline: AI Workflows Made Simple.

Keys to AI publishes free, step-by-step tutorials and resources. The brand's content is hosted by Simone Keys, an AI avatar and educator (Keys to AI is transparent that Simone is AI-generated). Every workflow taught is one the brand actually uses — "simple enough to repeat, useful enough to save real hours."

## What Keys to AI covers
- No-code AI workflows for solopreneurs, creators, and small businesses
- Tool tutorials: Claude (writing and automation), HeyGen (AI avatars and video), ElevenLabs (AI voice), Make.com (workflow automation), and Notion (business organization)
- Free downloadable resources: planning worksheets, prompt packs, automation checklists, and an interactive solopreneur toolkit

## Best for
Solopreneurs and small business owners — beginner to intermediate with AI — who want to save time on repetitive tasks, create content with AI, and build repeatable systems using affordable, no-code tools.

## Publishing
New tutorials weekly on YouTube; a newsletter every Monday with the single AI workflow worth your time that week.
